newsitem.title: ESTONIA: HANSAPANK UP AFTER Q1 ON BUSY MARKET.
newsitem.headline: HANSAPANK UP AFTER Q1 ON BUSY MARKET.

text.p: * Total trade on the Estonian bourse at 0800 GMT was 15.1
* The Talse index was 2.20 percent higher on 265.58
* Hansapank saw trade of 3.9 million kroons to be higher on
275.25/280.00 kroons versus Friday's 269.50 kroons after it
* Uhispank was the most active stock with 5.0
* Dealers said morning trade was very busy with strong
interest in Hansapank and continued interest in Uhispank.
Early trade on the Estonian bourse was very busy with Hansapank's price jumping after it released its first quarter consolidated results, dealers said.
Share trade on the main list by 0830 GMT was 14.3 million kroons and the Talse index was 2.23 percent higher at 265.66.

Hansapank saw trade of 3.9 million kroons to climb to 280.00/281.95 kroons versus 269.50 kroons after it announced first quarter consolidated net income of 136.1 million kroons versus 52.5 million kroons.
"The figures for Hansapank were good, but we are expecting selling pressure to take the stock back down," one dealer said.
Another dealer said the results were "very, very good" but he said the share price may not get much higher.
Uhispank was the most active stock with 5.1 million kroons of shares traded. The stock was slightly higher with a spread of 56.65/57.00 kroons compared to Friday's 56.50 kroons.
Trade on the free market was slow with Rakvere meat plant the most active stock but with volumes under one million kroons of shares.
Rakvere turned over 600,000 kroons of shares to be lower on 15.90/15.90 kroons versus Friday's 16.00.
